rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth consistently outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 1.76% (15.57% vs 13.81%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 65.3% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.71 vs benchmark 0.56, Sortino 0.87.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 2.81% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.77).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-37.44% vs -37.92%).
Rolling return range spans 2.06% to 26.59% (24.53 pp spread) — consistency score 79.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
